observations: Photo 0 shows an Xbox console with the Xbox logo on the front panel and a wireless controller placed on top.
Photo 1 shows the side/front of the console with the controller in the foreground; no cables or power adapter visible.
Photo 2 shows the vented perforated top surface and the front/side area; no storage label or model/serial visible.

read_from: photo 0 (Xbox logo and One S-style controller/console look)

claims.evidence: Photos do not show the storage capacity (no label/Settings screen) to confirm 1TB.
Photo 0 shows one wireless controller on top of the console.
No photo/video of the console home screen, installed games list, or storage/game tiles.

risks.risk: Storage capacity may not be 1TB (could be 500GB/other).
risks.proof: A photo/video of Settings > System > Storage showing the total capacity, or a clear label/serial sticker with capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not-confirmed capacity (worst case: treat as lower-capacity/unknown).

risks.risk: Console may have faults (disc drive issues, overheating, HDMI/port issues, controller pairing issues).
risks.proof: A short video of power-on to the home screen plus a quick test: controller connects and you can navigate; ideally show HDMI output working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully tested / worst case (assume issues until proven).

risks.risk: Games installed may be different from what’s expected, or none may be installed.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the Xbox home screen showing installed games (or the My games & apps list).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as no confirmed installed games.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller charging cable/battery type).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included items laid out (power brick/adapter if any, HDMI cable, controller batteries/charging method).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming only what’s shown (console + controller), with missing cables treated as not included.

proof_requests: Show Settings > System > Storage to confirm the exact capacity (1TB).
Show a video of the console booting to the home screen with the controller connected and working.
Show the installed games list (My games & apps) or home screen tiles proving games are installed.
Show all included accessories clearly laid out (power/HDMI and anything else included).
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox One S-style console and one controller, but they do not prove the key pricing drivers: 1TB storage, whether games are actually installed, and whether the console works with the included accessories. Without those, a safe worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
